hero.heading: A little quiet when you need it.
hero.intro: kū-on is a private set of short exercises for moments when anxiety, shame, anger, resentment, or overwhelm feels hard to hold. Breathe, ground, release tension, or take one small step through what is happening.

tools.heading: Begin wherever you are.
tools.intro: If you know what might help, go straight there. If you do not, choose what feels loudest and kū-on will offer one small place to start.
tools.emphasis: Use one exercise or stay a little longer. Everything after the first step is optional.

items.name: Right now
items.description: Choose what feels loudest and begin with a quick reset.

items.name: Breathe
items.description: Follow a simple rhythm when your body is running fast.

items.name: Ground
items.description: Bring your attention back to what is here around you.

items.name: Settle
items.description: Release some of the tension your body is carrying.

items.name: Let go
items.description: Put down what you are carrying in words that are never saved or sent.

items.name: Untangle
items.description: Work gently through shame or guilt without turning yourself into the punishment.

origin.statement: “I made kū-on for the moments when I needed help before I could explain what was wrong.”
origin.label: A personal project
origin.copy: I wanted something I could open immediately, use without preparation, and leave without turning it into another obligation. The aim is deliberately small: help make the next few minutes feel more manageable.

expectations.heading: Designed to ask very little of you.

items.heading: Open and begin
items.copy: No account or setup is required. You do not need to name the feeling perfectly before you start.

items.heading: Private by default
items.copy: What you enter is not saved, uploaded, or sent by kū-on. Your difficult moments remain yours.

items.heading: No performance
items.copy: No scores, streaks, or pressure to continue. Stopping after one breath is still using the app as intended.

name_section.heading: The name started with a feeling.
name_section.body: More room to breathe, and the quiet that follows once you have it. It’s not a word you find, but one formed from two ideas that belonged together.
name_section.closing: Together: kū-on (空穏), a clear, calm sky. The quiet space this name was built to hold.

closing.heading: You do not have to solve everything right now.
closing.copy: Use one exercise, stay for a few minutes, or leave whenever you want.
